The current limitation of computing means does not make it possible to answer the increasing needs of calculations Environment and safeguard Ground. The models are modernized, more powerful while the means do not follow.
The implementation of new computing resources will have to allow numerical modelling of fluids requiring parallel computing power and storage.
The system characteristics must at least meet the following requirements
- 12 parallel connections 
- 2 operating systems used Windows and Linux
- 1 data server allowing archiving, backup and restoration of data (hot)
- 3 networks, two of which interface with the CSG systems
The portage between the old and the new means must be integrated
